history.summary: A Shakti shrine dedicated to the ten-armed goddess Narayani, located in Narayani village near Khallikote in Ganjam district, at the foot of the Valleri (Vallery) hills amid forested country near Chilika. It is a popular pilgrimage and picnic spot drawing devotees from Berhampur and the surrounding region. The temple's founding date and builders are UNVERIFIED — no reliable source found. NOTE: CSV town 'Berhampur' is approximate; the temple is at Narayani village (Khallikote area), ~35-40 km from Berhampur town (verify).

name: Narayani Devi Temple
town_description: Narayani is a small village near Khallikote in Ganjam district of southern Odisha, set at the foot of the forested Valleri hills not far from Chilika Lake and the Balugaon railway junction. Khallikote is a historic estate town on the Chennai–Kolkata highway (NH-16) corridor. The village's main claim to fame is the Narayani temple, which draws weekend and pilgrimage crowds from Berhampur and nearby areas.
